ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Base your answer on the food chain below and on your knowledge of science. What is the producer in this food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a food chain/food web. At the top is a plant labeled “plant,” with arrows from the plant pointing to ants and poison dart; ants then point to lizards, and poison dart then continues to connect downward through the following animals. Reasoning: In a food chain, producers are organisms that can make their own food, usually plants; the animals in the figure are all consumers. Therefore, the producer in this food chain is the plant.
